name: Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD
summary: Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD, together with its subsidiaries, develops, operates, manages, and sells real estate properties in China. The company is also involved in the mining investment business; leasing and financing activities; and management of outlets, as well as operates a hotel. In addition, it provides sales agencies, urban renewal, real estate brokerage, catering, guestrooms, and food and beverage services, as well as operates shopping mall. Tibet Urban Development and Investment Co.,LTD was formerly known as Tibet Jinzhu Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Lhasa, China.
